title: Vehicle, Mecha, Ship & Fleet Integration
objective: Implement visibility-first deterministic integration of explicit vehicle, mecha and ship operational references into completed SCL squad/fleet projections while preserving canonical Asset/Vehicle, actor, command, logistics, position, combat and damage authority.

fleet_source_rules: Squad & Fleet source describes a squad as 1-5 ships and a fleet as multiple squads led by a flagship or command ship.
The source-specific 1-5 ship squad statement is retained as source evidence only and does not replace the frozen SCL-01/SCL-02 scale taxonomy or create a universal numeric size cap.
Flagship/command-ship leadership is projected only when an explicit canonical reference exists; SCL-08 never infers a leader from ordering, ownership, class, or UI position.
authority_rules: SCL-08 is a visibility-first deterministic integration projection linking SCL-02 profile/membership identity to canonical F008 Asset Instances and F014 Vehicle Operations; it never copies or forks owner truth.
Ownership, custody, possession/control, access, passenger status and station authority remain distinct; ownership or custody never implies station authority.
Crew/station actor references remain distinct from vehicle/mecha/ship Asset identity; pilot or crew state is never merged into machine state and no pilot damage is inferred from machine damage.
F014 owns operational classes, stations, vehicle states, movement, Resources, installed systems, docking, boarding, launch, capture and governed vehicle commands.
SCL-03/SCL-04 retain command/order authority and deterministic command coordination; SCL-08 may reference command/order handoffs but does not issue, prioritize, resolve or execute orders.
SCL-06 retains logistics/readiness evidence; SCL-08 may reference Resource/readiness handoffs but does not consume fuel, ammunition, power, heat, maintenance, repair or supply state.
SCL-07/World retain semantic position and environment truth; SCL-08 may reference visible position/docking relations but does not move or place Assets.
SCL-09 retains individual-to-unit casualty, damage and recovery reconciliation; SCL-08 never propagates or aggregates damage/casualties across vehicle, crew, carried craft or fleet members.
Carried craft, cargo, passengers and nested Assets preserve separate identity; carrier damage or fleet membership never implicitly mutates children.

Visibility filters before platform rows, crew/station rosters, fleet bindings, counts, classes, states, source-rule references, summaries, search, provenance, handoffs, deterministic receipts or AI context; hidden existence/cardinality is undisclosed.
Missing, source-unspecified, unknown, conflict and incompatible evidence remains conservative; unknown is not zero, absent, available, compatible, full or unlimited.
Stable integration-id ordering exists only for deterministic output and never creates authority, priority or fleet command.
No owner mutation, autonomous AI command/adjudication, duplicate vehicle/fleet ledger, durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.

validation_requirements: Acceptance-first current-family SCL-08 test/proof/profile/verifier must establish genuine matching Linux/Windows RED before production surfaces exist.
Final exact-head Validation Core must run exactly one SCL-08 profile on self-hosted Linux and Windows and deterministic comparison with historical predecessor profile fanout zero.
Accessible nonvisual panel and deterministic stable ordering are required.
next_action: After exact-head AIOC Repository Health passes and this governed-start authority merges, create the SCL-08 application branch at exact baseline 154a72bbcabfe6fe21a99e219ef1afe1863bb061 and establish genuine acceptance-first RED before production mutation.
